comparison.objective: Identify two 8 cm spacers by measurement and kit only those parts; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual/physical ruler comparison, discrimination among similar parts, and pick-and-place versus hex-key insertion, fine rotation, stabilization, and iterative impact evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly both 8 cm spacers and nothing else must enter the cup; candidate requires ordered mechanical operations and two bounded carriage stops. Measurement tolerance is not stated.
comparison.reason: Metrology-driven part selection differs materially from mechanical adjustment.
